title: Put the Sentences in Order
ringkas: Menyusun paragraf yang runtut dengan kata penghubung dan alur waktu
goals: memakai **penanda urutan** (first, then, finally) dan **kata ganti** sebagai petunjuk
membaca teks prosedur, cerita, dan deskripsi dengan alur jelas

lesson.text: Paragraf yang baik bukan sekadar kumpulan kalimat; kalimatnya **berurutan** dan saling menyambung. Pada latihan ini kamu mengetuk kalimat satu per satu sesuai urutan yang benar. Gunakan petunjuk di dalam kalimat untuk menebak urutannya.

lesson.title: 1. Petunjuk untuk menyusun urutan
table: First di awal, Finally di akhir
kata ganti muncul setelah nama atau benda disebut
urut dari awal ke akhir hari

examples.en: [[First, I wake up. Then I take a shower. Finally, I eat breakfast.]]
examples.id: Pertama, aku bangun. Lalu aku mandi. Terakhir, aku sarapan.

lesson.title: Cari awal dan akhirnya dulu
lesson.text: Temukan kalimat yang memperkenalkan topik (awal) dan kalimat yang menyimpulkan (akhir). Kalimat di tengah mengikuti urutan waktu atau alasan.

items: Awal: kalimat topik atau First.
Tengah: Then, Next, After that, waktu.
Akhir: Finally atau That is why.
Kata ganti mengikuti nama/benda yang sudah disebut.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi paragraf yang runtut.
items: I had a very busy morning.
First, I woke up at five and cleaned my room.
Then I cooked rice for my family.
After that, I walked to school with my friends.
Finally, I arrived just before the bell rang.
practice.exp: Awal: kalimat topik; tengah: urutan waktu First-Then-After that; akhir: Finally.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi paragraf yang runtut.
items: Making tea is easy.
First, boil some water in a kettle.
Next, put a tea bag into a cup.
Then pour the hot water into the cup.
Finally, add sugar and enjoy your tea.
practice.exp: Prosedur: First, Next, Then, Finally.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi paragraf yang runtut.
items: Last Sunday we visited my grandmother.
We left home early in the morning.
After two hours, we arrived at her village.
She cooked a big lunch for us.
In the evening, we said goodbye and went home.
practice.exp: Urutan waktu: berangkat, tiba, makan, pulang.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi paragraf yang runtut.
items: Rani wanted to buy a new bag.
She went to the market on Saturday.
She found a blue bag, but it was too expensive.
After that, she bargained with the seller.
In the end, she bought the bag at a good price.
practice.exp: Urutan peristiwa: ingin, pergi, menemukan, menawar, membeli.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi paragraf yang runtut.
items: My cat is very clever.
Every morning it wakes me up by jumping on my bed.
Then it follows me to the kitchen.
It waits quietly while I prepare its food.
That is why I love my cat so much.
practice.exp: Topik di awal; That is why menyimpulkan di akhir.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi paragraf yang runtut.
items: Tom wanted to wash his motorbike.
First, he filled a bucket with water.
Then he wet the bike and added soap.
Next, he cleaned it with a soft cloth.
Finally, he dried it in the sun.
practice.exp: Prosedur mencuci: isi ember, basahi, bersihkan, keringkan.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi paragraf yang runtut.
items: It was raining heavily.
Dina forgot her umbrella.
She waited under a tree for twenty minutes.
Then a kind man offered her a ride.
As a result, she got home dry.
practice.exp: Sebab (hujan) sebelum akibat (menunggu, tumpangan, tiba kering).

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi paragraf yang runtut.
items: Our school has a library.
It is on the second floor.
Students can borrow two books at a time.
They must return the books after two weeks.
Because of this rule, everyone has a chance to read.
practice.exp: Topik, lokasi, aturan, kewajiban, akibat.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi paragraf yang runtut.
items: To send an email, open your email program first.
Then click the button for a new message.
Next, type the address and the subject.
After you write your message, check it carefully.
Finally, click Send.
practice.exp: Prosedur: buka, klik, ketik, periksa, kirim.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi paragraf yang runtut.
items: Budi lost his wallet on the bus.
He realised it when he wanted to pay for lunch.
Then he called the bus company.
A driver had found the wallet and kept it safe.
Budi was very happy to get it back.
practice.exp: Kehilangan, sadar, menelepon, ditemukan, senang.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi paragraf yang runtut.
items: Yesterday was my brother's birthday.
In the morning, we decorated the living room.
At noon, his friends came to our house.
We sang a song and he blew out the candles.
At night, everybody was tired but happy.
practice.exp: Pagi, siang, malam.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi paragraf yang runtut.
items: Planting a tree is not difficult.
First, dig a hole in the ground.
Then put the young tree into the hole.
Next, cover the roots with soil.
Finally, give the tree plenty of water.
practice.exp: Prosedur menanam: gali, taruh, tutup, siram.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi paragraf yang runtut.
items: Dina is learning to cook.
At first, she burned the rice.
Then she asked her mother for help.
Her mother showed her how to use the stove.
Now Dina cooks dinner every Friday.
practice.exp: At first, Then, kini (Now).

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi paragraf yang runtut.
items: The train was late this morning.
Many passengers waited on the platform.
After thirty minutes, an announcement told them about the delay.
Finally, the train arrived and everyone got on.
Fortunately, nobody missed their appointments.
practice.exp: Terlambat, menunggu, pengumuman, tiba, akibat.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi paragraf yang runtut.
items: Rice is an important food in Indonesia.
Farmers plant rice in wet fields.
After a few months, the plants turn yellow.
Then the farmers harvest the rice by hand.
At last, the rice is dried and sold at the market.
practice.exp: Proses padi: tanam, menguning, panen, jual.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi paragraf yang runtut.
items: I always keep a diary.
Every night before bed, I write about my day.
I describe what I did and how I felt.
Sometimes I read old pages and smile.
In short, my diary helps me remember happy times.
practice.exp: Topik, kebiasaan, isi, kadang, In short.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi paragraf yang runtut.
items: Mr. Adi is a teacher.
He arrives at school at seven every morning.
First, he checks the homework.
Then he teaches English until noon.
In the afternoon, he helps students who need extra lessons.
practice.exp: Topik, tiba, First, Then, sore hari.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi paragraf yang runtut.
items: The weather changed suddenly.
First, dark clouds covered the sky.
Then a strong wind began to blow.
A few minutes later, it started to rain.
Soon the street was empty.
practice.exp: Cuaca berubah: awan, angin, hujan, sepi.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi paragraf yang runtut.
items: Tom was nervous about the interview.
He prepared answers the night before.
On the day, he arrived fifteen minutes early.
During the interview, he spoke slowly and clearly.
Two days later, he received a job offer.
practice.exp: Persiapan, hari H, saat wawancara, hasil.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi paragraf yang runtut.
items: Recycling helps the environment.
First, separate paper, plastic, and glass.
Next, put each type in a different bin.
Then the collectors take the bins to a factory.
As a result, the materials can be used again.
practice.exp: Prosedur daur ulang: pisahkan, taruh, ambil, hasil.

items: I had a very busy morning.

After that, I walked to school with my friends.
Finally, I arrived just before the bell rang.
practice.exp: Awal: kalimat topik; tengah: urutan waktu First-Then-After that; akhir: Finally.
